children: A consortium led by Dell Chief Executive Michael Dell's DFO Management is taking insurance brokerage Baldwin Group private in a cash deal valued at $7.7 billion.

Under the deal, Baldwin Group's shareholders will receive $32.50 a share in cash, which represents a premium of about 88% to the unaffected closing price on June 17, the day before media reports surfaced that the company was exploring a take-private deal.
The transaction implies a total enterprise value of approximately $7.7 billion, comprised of an equity purchase price of about $4.6 billion and about $3.1 billion of debt.
